name: Design Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
benefit:
> **Design Project:**

  - Financial assistance under this activity will be utilised for engagement of design consultants for design interventions and expenses pertaining to development of prototype/product. For the design projects approved for any MSME, 75% (Micro) and 60% (Small &amp; Medium) of the total project cost will be contributed by Government of India, up to a maximum of ₹ 40,000
_eligibility_text: - The beneficiary unit(s) must typically be registered micro, small or medium enterprises. - Should have a valid Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration certificate.
